dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: extranodal disease in the right kidney, left adrenal gland and liver

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms: drenching night sweats and about 8 kg unintentional weight loss

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: MYC/BCL2 expression is below the usual double-expressor thresholds

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5/5 (age >60, stage IV, elevated LDH, ECOG 2, more than one extranodal site), high risk.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6 (age >60, elevated LDH, ECOG >1, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, renal/adrenal involvement)

tx_pola_preferred.quote: If polatuzumab is not accessible, R-CHOP x6 is the accepted standard alternative.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: Do not reduce dose preemptively for ECOG 2

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High: CNS-IPI 6/6 with renal and adrenal involvement

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: No testicular ultrasound or brain MRI is needed without symptoms.
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: LP with CSF cytology/flow planned, but brain MRI explicitly declined.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate because his CrCl is about 47 mL/min.
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX feasibility to renal function and notes debated benefit, but commits to IT MTX rather than framing as individualized option.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment FDG PET-CT using Lugano/Deauville criteria about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 indicates residual disease, with biopsy if feasible

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: aggressive IV hydration and every 6-12 hour monitoring of urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine and LDH during cycle 1

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD and give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg if normal

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim 6 mg after each cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen immediately; use acetaminophen and short-acting opioids for pain

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Monitor glucose closely during prednisone and adjust metformin/insulin

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is not needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative

work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 60% cited as reason for regimen; anthracycline candidacy stated separately.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: ECOG 2, but the impairment is largely from bulky lymphoma, weight loss and pain
